transcript: It was a spring morning when I learned that my wife was pregnant Along with joy, a great responsibility settled on my shoulders Nine months later, our infant was born Our son, small hands, small feet A peaceful sleeping face Just by being there, the world seemed to change But raising a child was far tougher than I had imagined babies cry regardless of day or night frequently we were kept busy with feeding and changing diapers lack of sleep was severe even when we desperately wanted sleep the sound of his crying woke us immediately My wife and I were both exhausted And yet the moment our son laughed All the fatigue blew away The feel of his small hand Gripping my finger When I feel the heartbeat in his chest As he sleeps I feel deeply happy Raising a child is also a process that makes a parent apparent While we seem to be raising the child We are in truth being raised by the child Patience, endurance, unconditional love My son drew out of me qualities I had never possessed before A few years later, my son began attending nursery school Every morning at parting, he waves his small hand The relationship between my son and me We'll develop over a long journey until he is a teenager, until he is an adult, until one day he leaves home.

segments.text: It was a spring morning when I learned that my wife was pregnant
Along with joy, a great responsibility settled on my shoulders
Nine months later, our infant was born
Our son, small hands, small feet
A peaceful sleeping face
Just by being there, the world seemed to change
But raising a child was far tougher
than I had imagined
babies cry regardless of day or night
frequently
we were kept busy with feeding and changing diapers
lack of sleep was severe
even when we desperately wanted sleep
the sound of his crying woke us immediately
My wife and I were both exhausted
And yet the moment our son laughed
All the fatigue blew away
The feel of his small hand
Gripping my finger
When I feel the heartbeat in his chest
As he sleeps I feel deeply happy
Raising a child is also a process that makes a parent apparent
While we seem to be raising the child
We are in truth being raised by the child
Patience, endurance, unconditional love
My son drew out of me qualities I had never possessed before
A few years later, my son began attending nursery school
Every morning at parting, he waves his small hand
The relationship between my son and me
We'll develop over a long journey until he is a teenager, until he is an adult, until
one day he leaves home.
